# JagDroid v0.60-experimental

- Phase Zero: the ground in the level rendered as blue noise. Single-pixel Gouraud blits now take their shade from the lane the game actually writes it to, so the ground is smoothly shaded. (Set JAG_X_OLDGOUR on desktop to get the old behaviour.)
- The black screen after the menus was not reproducible on desktop; please retest on device.
